name: Bank Farm Leisure
stayType: Holiday park with pitches, pods and bungalows
accommodation: About 180 tent, touring and motorhome pitches, glamping pods, self-catering bungalows (two with hot tubs)
beachAccess: In Horton, overlooking Horton and Port Eynon bays
confirmedFeatures: Clubhouse with bar and food, outdoor heated pool with retractable roof, tennis court, adventure playground, shop, launderette, Wi-Fi
overview: Bank Farm is a holiday park in Horton, on the slope above Horton and Port Eynon bays. As well as tent and touring pitches it has glamping pods and self-catering bungalows, and its facilities include a clubhouse with a bar and food, a heated pool and a shop.
surfTripFit: It overlooks the same stretch of beach as Port Eynon and has plenty to keep a family busy on flat days.
